title: Payment Idempotency Store Redis Cluster Failover — Duplicate Debit Charges

content.summary: During a Redis cluster master failover on 2024-07-09, a 37-second window of lost idempotency state caused 214 card payment retries to be processed as new transactions, resulting in duplicate debit charges to customers.

timeline.event: Redis primary node network partition detected; automatic failover to replica begins
During 37-second failover window, payment-gateway retries reach new primary with no idempotency state
214 retry transactions processed as new payments; duplicate debits initiated
Automated duplicate-charge detection alerts (same card, same amount, < 60 seconds apart)
All 214 duplicate charges reversed; incident resolved

content.root_cause: Redis replication uses asynchronous writes, meaning in-flight idempotency keys written to the primary node but not yet replicated were lost during the failover. The payment-gateway did not implement a 'wait for replication' strategy (WAIT command) for idempotency key writes, accepting the performance trade-off but not accounting for the duplicate-payment risk.
contributing_factors: Idempotency key replication not synchronous (async replication design decision not reviewed for payment risk)
Same architectural weakness as INC-2024-002 and INC-2024-007 — idempotency store reliability gap
Retry logic in payment-gateway did not check for the idempotency store being in failover state before retrying
Duplicate-charge detection threshold was 60 seconds — failover window was 37 seconds, meaning some duplicates were caught late

immediate: Implement WAIT 1 500 on idempotency key writes (synchronous replication to 1 replica)
short_term: Switch idempotency store to Redis Cluster with synchronous replication (JIRA PAY-9300)
Add failover-state awareness to payment-gateway retry logic (JIRA PAY-9301)
Lower duplicate-charge detection window from 60 s to 10 s (JIRA PAY-9302)
long_term: Evaluate PostgreSQL-backed idempotency store for durability guarantees (cross-reference ARCH-004)
Design payment-gateway to be idempotency-store-failure-safe by using two-phase commit
Quarterly Redis failover drill with idempotency validation
